propositions: the DC transport must implement TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, and SupportsAbsenceProbe on top of pycontribs/jira as an opt-in extra, with methods returning raw payload shapes not jira.Issue objects
bearer token auth from JIRA_PAT env var and config-driven JIRA_URL/JIRA_PROJECT must fail loudly on ConfigError rather than degrade to env-only
http errors are attempted exactly once while connection timeouts retry with 2s/5s backoff matching acli_rest behavior
tls is never disabled; a non-https base_url is rejected unless allow_insecure=true, with cert verification never relaxed; ca_bundle configures internal CAs
resolved_statuses config key sets the absence probe's resolved-status set, defaulting to {Resolved, Done, Cancelled} for DC workflows that differ from Cloud/DIG names

the DC backend self-registers on import through adapters/__init__.py so select_backend('jira-datacenter') resolves in runtime registry lookup, and all TicketTransport methods pass live tests against the J5 harness with authoritative NameIdentity user-search coverage
